cohort: The study included 169,583 low-risk primiparous mothers with singleton, cephalic labours, from 1999 to 2009.
finding: The study identified a close association between increasing maternal age and an elevated risk of emergency operative delivery in low-risk primiparous women, primarily driven by dystocia.
mod_finding: Older maternal age significantly increased the risk of both emergency caesarean section and operative vaginal delivery.
